name: live-viewer
description: Watch Claude's tool calls live in a side-pane tab: Write, Edit and Bash as boxes with streaming code and diffs, other tools as one line, thinking, answers and the todo list.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the tab title and labels. auto: Korean when your locale (LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG) is Korean or your time zone is Asia/Seoul, English otherwise

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Box colors. auto: light in the desktop app, follows the theme in the terminal

debug.title: Debug status file
debug.description: Write a per-session status file under live-viewer/status/ in the Claude config folder
